question: What is the performance of the baseline?
title: X-Stance: A Multilingual Multi-Target Dataset for Stance Detection
answer_short: The baseline accuracy is comparable to previous stance detection benchmarks while leaving ample room for improvement.
answer_rationale: The document states in Text 10 (page 1, section Introduction) that 'We show that the baseline accuracy is comparable to previous stance detection benchmarks while leaving ample room for improvement.' This directly answers the question about the performance of the baseline.
